name: Heather Loretta
source: One of the most beautiful and perfect looking girls at the academy. She is known by other students as “Princess” as they’ve given her the nickname for being the student council president. Don’t let this princess fool you, she enjoys being mean and bullying others to get what she wants in return. She comes from a rich family, which also plays into how she thinks too highly of herself and looks down on others as her servants.
